title: Standing Together in Prayer
description: An overflow crowd from a mosque in Dhaka, Bangladesh, pours into the streets for a prayer marking the end of Ramadan. The majority of the country's population is Muslim, although there is a small population of Hindu and Buddhist worshippers as well. Eid al-Fitr is the multiday celebration that follows Ramadan, and like many other Muslim countries, Bangladesh observes it with prayer, family gatherings, gift giving, and festive feasts.
translated_description: 孟加拉国达卡一座清真寺内人潮涌动，信众涌入街道进行斋月结束的祈祷。该国绝大多数人口为穆斯林，但也有少量印度教和佛教信徒。开斋节是斋月后持续数日的庆典，与许多其他穆斯林国家一样，孟加拉国通过祈祷、家庭聚会、互赠礼物和节日盛宴来庆祝这一节日。
